source: Owned Channel Operating Playbook v3.0 §4.1 (docs/playbook-v3.0.md). Etsy stack is marked [V], verified against https://www.etsy.com/legal/fees/ on or before 2026-10-21. Payhip 5% platform fee cited from https://payhip.com/pricing; card processing is passed through by Stripe/PayPal and is [C] (confirm in the live account).

etsy.notes: Transaction fee applies to price + shipping + gift wrap, not US sales tax. Processing applies to the total incl. tax and shipping.

payhip.notes: 5% is the free-plan platform fee. The 2.9% + $0.30 processing line is an assumed Stripe US rate, not confirmed.
